subject: Discovery recap + rotating deep-dive slots
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@atlasnova.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@atlasnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + rotating deep-dive slots

Hi Jamie / Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: validate latency and cost tradeoffs for your inference-heavy reporting pipeline.
- Key stakeholders for the technical deep-dive: Liam (infra), Jamie (product), and two SREs (TBD).
- Success metric for the deep-dive: get a repeatable perf baseline + action items for proof-of-concept (POC).

To make the deep-dive easier for your global team, we proposed rotating slots so the same Redwood engineers can run the session at reasonable local hours for AtlasNova across regions. Proposed rotating cadence (three-week rotation):
- Week A (US-focused): 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — shorter demo + infra Q&A (60 min)
- Week B (EU-focused): 14:00 CET / 08:00 ET — deeper config walkthrough (75 min)
- Week C (APAC-focused): 16:00 SGT / 01:00 ET — compact deep-dive + follow-ups (60 min)

Can you confirm: 1) which week window you prefer to start with, and 2) whether we should include your SREs in the first session or schedule a separate session for them?

I've attached the discovery notes and a tentative .ics with a sample rotation. If that looks ok, I'll publish the three recurring windows and send calendar invites for the first 6 weeks so we can lock stakeholders.

Short next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred starting window and SRE attendance (reply)
- I publish rotating invites + agenda (Redwood)
- Karthik (SE) will prep a short benchmarking checklist and required access/credentials list

Thanks — talk soon.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@atlasnova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@atlasnova.com>
Date: 2025-10-20T20:35:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + rotating deep-dive slots

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the rotating cadence idea; that would solve most of our timezone friction.

Quick notes from our side:
- EU-focused window (Week B) fits best for the majority of product + data folks.
- We will include our SREs, but they asked for the first session to be the EU slot so they can attend live.
- Proposal: Start the rotation with Week B (EU) next Tuesday, then follow the three-week cycle.

Can you set up the invites and add the benchmarking checklist? Also, loop in whoever will run the KV-cache/quantization demo — Marissa?

Jamie Ortiz
Director, Product
AtlasNova Inc.

Thanks Jordan — I'll own the benchmarking checklist and the KV-cache demo. Attached is a short checklist and a sample .ics that creates the three recurring windows (we named them Week-A/Week-B/Week-C). Notes:
- If we start with Week B next Tue (2025-10-28 14:00 CET), I'll prepare a pre-read (short) covering quantization options and required endpoints/credentials.
- For the SREs: please forward any required firewall/IP allowlists; we'll provide a stub list in the pre-read.

I'll publish the invites once Jamie confirms the attendee list for the first session.
